sourceRows.zh: n.陈腐的 走了气的 (动物的)尿 adj.不新鲜的 陈腐的 失效的 vt.使腐坏vi.变得不新鲜 腐坏 (动物)撒尿

senses.zh: n.戳子 邮票 标志 图章 印 跺脚 v.跺脚 盖章

ex.en: That is, if you put a postage stamp on upside down, you'll go to prison.

col: stamp a passport｜在护照上盖章
tip: 邮票用a stamp；“在信封上贴邮票”用put a stamp on。

sourceRows.zh: n.戳子 邮票 标志 图章 印 跺脚 v.跺脚 盖章

senses.zh: vi.站 坐落 位于 停滞 忍受 n.架 台 站立 停顿 楼台 货摊

ex.en: A child deviates from social pressures when they stand up for another child being bullied in school.
Our students—Asian, Latino, African American, Native American, and, yes, white—stand to gain from a multicultural curriculum.

col: can't stand doing something｜无法忍受做某事
take a stand｜表明坚定立场
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为stood；忍受常用can't stand。

sourceRows.zh: vi.站 坐落 位于 停滞 忍受 n.架 台 站立 停顿 楼台 货摊

senses.zh: n.标准 规格 adj.标准的 规范的 普通的

ex.en: Thus, they had to keep working just as much in order to maintain their standard of living.
One water bottle company launched recycled half-litre "eco" bottles alongside its standard bottles.

tip: 达到标准用meet a standard；生活水平用standard of living。

sourceRows.zh: n.标准 规格 adj.标准的 规范的 普通的

senses.zh: n.立场 观点

ex.en: From a food safety standpoint, if you have millions or more bacteria on a surface, 0.1% is still enough to make you sick.
They note that the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint.

col: from a practical standpoint｜从实际角度看
from an economic standpoint｜从经济角度看
from someone's standpoint｜从某人的立场看
tip: 常用from a ... standpoint表示“从……角度看”。

sourceRows.zh: n.立场 观点

senses.zh: n.星 恒星 明星 v.以星状物装饰 变成演员

ex.en: You can see why he wanted to come here; equally, the island knows exactly what kind of star watching it prefers.
One in ten Americans has tried to look like a star.

col: a rising star｜冉冉升起的新星
star in a film｜主演电影
tip: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。

sourceRows.zh: n.星 恒星 明星 v.以星状物装饰 变成演员

senses.zh: vi.盯 凝视 vt.显眼 (毛发)竖立 n.凝视

ex.en: Parents who stare non-stop at their phones and don't read books are likely to breed kids who will do the same.
You know that part at the end of a job interview when the hiring manager asks if you have any questions, and you just stare across the table blankly with your mouth hanging open?

tip: stare at强调长时间盯看；glance at指瞥一眼。

sourceRows.zh: vi.盯 凝视 vt.显眼 (毛发)竖立 n.凝视

senses.zh: vi.跳起 出发 开始 起身 vt.开始 使震惊 n.起点 震动 领先优势 起推动作用的外力

ex.en: Eating pancakes on the balcony overlooking the unspoilt white sandy beach was a great way to start the day.
Without any ambition, you wouldn't start your own business, set or achieve goals and get far in life.

col: at the start of｜在……开始时
make a fresh start｜重新开始
tip: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

sourceRows.zh: vi.跳起 出发 开始 起身 vt.开始 使震惊 n.起点 震动 领先优势 起推动作用的外力

senses.zh: vt.使大吃一惊 使...惊愕 n.吃惊 惊愕

ex.en: The sudden knock startled me while I was cooking.
ex.zh: 我做饭时，突然的敲门声吓了我一跳。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

ex.en: Loud construction noises can startle nearby wildlife and disrupt their feeding patterns during the breeding season.
ex.zh: 繁殖季节，巨大的施工噪声会惊吓附近的野生动物，扰乱它们的觅食规律。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

tip: 强调突然受惊，不等于长期感到害怕。

sourceRows.zh: vt.使大吃一惊 使...惊愕 n.吃惊 惊愕

senses.zh: vi.饿死 挨饿 受饿 vt.使饿死 使挨饿

ex.en: If feeding is stopped during severe weather, birds used to relying upon the feeders must starve.

col: be starved of resources｜严重缺乏资源
tip: 日常说I'm starving表示饿极了，并非濒临饿死。

sourceRows.zh: vi.饿死 挨饿 受饿 vt.使饿死 使挨饿

senses.zh: n.状态 国家 州 情形 adj.国家的 州的 正式的 vt.说 说明阐明 陈述 声明 规定

ex.en: The quest to attain this mysterious state has dominated discussion around careers for years—especially for working parents.
In the U.S., 29% of drivers admit they surf behind the wheel, according to insurance firm State Farm.

col: in a good state｜处于良好状态
tip: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。

sourceRows.zh: n.状态 国家 州 情形 adj.国家的 州的 正式的 vt.说 说明阐明 陈述 声明 规定

senses.zh: n.陈述 声明

ex.en: If you are not aware as to why scientists made the statement about the death of this wonderful thing, let us tell you the facts.
Such findings prompted the American Academy of Pediatrics to issue a policy statement in 2013 on the "crucial role of recess in school."

tip: 作“陈述”时是可数名词；银行对账单也用statement。

sourceRows.zh: n.陈述 声明

senses.zh: n.政治家 国务活动家

ex.en: The retired statesman spoke calmly to the gathered crowd.
ex.zh: 这位退休的资深政治家平静地向聚集的人群讲话。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

ex.en: A respected statesman can help resolve international disputes by encouraging dialogue and building trust between governments.
ex.zh: 一位受尊敬的资深政治家可以通过鼓励对话、建立政府间信任，帮助解决国际争端。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

tip: 通常含褒义，不宜译作贬义的“政客”；女性用 stateswoman。

sourceRows.zh: n.政治家 国务活动家

senses.zh: adj.静的 静态的 静力的 静止的 静电的 n.静电 静电干扰 (猛烈的)反对或抨击

ex.en: The television picture stayed static while the sound continued.
ex.zh: 电视画面停住不动了，但声音还在继续。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

ex.en: Wages have remained static for several years, while housing costs have risen steadily in major cities.
ex.zh: 工资多年来一直没有变化，而大城市的住房成本却持续上涨。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

tip: static强调不动或不变；静电用static electricity。

sourceRows.zh: adj.静的 静态的 静力的 静止的 静电的 n.静电 静电干扰 (猛烈的)反对或抨击

senses.zh: n.站 台 所 局 车站 位置 地位 vt.安置 驻扎 配置

ex.en: At every station, more people squeezed in and I got pushed further and further inside.
The scientists first sent some mice in a specially designed cage to the International Space Station.

tip: 作动词常用被动式be stationed at，表示被派驻。

sourceRows.zh: n.站 台 所 局 车站 位置 地位 vt.安置 驻扎 配置

senses.zh: adj.统计的 统计学的

ex.en: For example, statistical studies that he and a colleague built of corn and soybean(大豆) production in the US show a steep decline after crossing the 30℃ temperature threshold(临界点).

tip: statistical指与统计有关，不等于“显著的”。

sourceRows.zh: adj.统计的 统计学的

senses.zh: n.塑像 雕像 铸像

ex.en: A bronze statue of a horse stands beside the fountain.
ex.zh: 喷泉旁矗立着一座马的铜像。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

ex.en: Public statues can preserve local history, but communities should discuss which figures deserve such recognition.
ex.zh: 公共雕像可以保存地方历史，但社区应讨论哪些人物值得获得这样的认可。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

tip: statue是雕像；status是地位，注意拼写区别。

sourceRows.zh: n.塑像 雕像 铸像

senses.zh: n.地位 身分 情形 状况

ex.en: The status of the upper classes was threatened; fashion was a tool to preserve it.
Later research in 2003, however, suggested high-protein diets could aid in weight loss, and protein quickly regained its former nutrient-superstar status.

tip: 既可指社会地位，也可指当前状况，注意语境。

sourceRows.zh: n.地位 身分 情形 状况

senses.zh: vi.停留 逗留 住 n.逗留 停留 支撑物 倚赖的人或事

ex.en: Fruit juice also has been linked to claims that it can help you both lose weight and stay healthy.
What caused more disruption was when schools tried to stay open in bad weather, even though many staff and pupils were absent.

tip: stay后可直接接形容词，如stay calm保持冷静。

sourceRows.zh: vi.停留 逗留 住 n.逗留 停留 支撑物 倚赖的人或事

senses.zh: adv.稳定地 不变地 稳固地 坚定地

ex.en: "We started Design Ventura with around 800 young people in 2010 and it has grown steadily since," she says.
Since the adoption of sweeping education reforms in 2001, public schools have steadily increased the amount of time devoted to preparing for standardized tests.

col: work steadily｜持续有条不紊地工作
tip: 图表写作常用rise steadily，指平稳上升而非猛增。

sourceRows.zh: adv.稳定地 不变地 稳固地 坚定地

senses.zh: adj.稳固的 稳定的 坚定的 vt.使稳定 使稳固 (变得)稳固 adv.平稳地 稳固地 n.固定的事物

ex.en: For some, the hardships of life without steady work eventually overwhelmed their attempts to keep their families together.
The fact that attitudes toward self-driving cars appear to be so steady across generations suggests how transformative the shift to driverless cars could be.

tip: steady作形容词；修饰动词通常用steadily。

sourceRows.zh: adj.稳固的 稳定的 坚定的 vt.使稳定 使稳固 (变得)稳固 adv.平稳地 稳固地 n.固定的事物

senses.zh: vt.偷 窍取 n.偷窃 便宜货 (欺诈的)政治交易

ex.en: As investor Pedro Sorrentino put it, "If you don't guard your time, people will steal it from you."
"In fact, the camera could be the thing that proves that they didn't steal the $20, or knock the vase off the table."

col: steal from someone｜偷某人的东西
tip: 过去式stole，过去分词stolen；宾语通常是物。

sourceRows.zh: vt.偷 窍取 n.偷窃 便宜货 (欺诈的)政治交易
